name: DF-21D anti-ship ballistic missile on its five-axle TEL (the 2015 Beijing parade vehicle)

published.source: en.wikipedia 'DF-21': the round 10.7 m long, 1.4 m in diameter (the DF-21 family figure; NOT CONFIRMED for the D). No figure of the TEL (the truck) is published: its 11.68 m is the model's own X extent, from the canister's tail to the bumper's tow hooks, scaled off [DF1] on the round.

engine_contract.row: js/eras.js row pla_e00_df21d; js/hero/misc_borrowed.js builds it through HeroMiscBorrowed.df21d (buildTel('df21d'))
engine_contract.current_nodes: five 'roadwheel' axle groups (axle on local Y, origin on the axle, z = tyre radius 0.61); one 'podelev' group hinged at (-5.40, 0, 1.45) with userData.el (radians, the erect angle render3d poseLauncher raises to) and userData.cells [[mouth x, y, z, rear x]]

references.name: [DF1] DF-21D TEL, 2015 parade, near side-on from the starboard side, nose right
references.source: Wikimedia Commons 'Dongfeng-21D.JPG' (1280 x 956; cached by the first builder in the scratchpad q_misc_ref)
references.note: Scale: the round, canister tail (px 185) to the tip of the pale nose (px 1015), taken as the published 10.7 m: 77.6 px/m (NOT CONFIRMED that the canister ends at the round's tail). Ground: the foot of the near front-pair tyre, px y 607. The photograph is oblique - the cab is nearer the camera than the tail and the vehicle is turning at the corner - and the running gear is in deep shadow, so it is kept as 'quarter' (not outlined) and its readings are landmarks in side axes. Readings (px -> m, x = -5.64 + (px - 185) / 77.6, z = (607 - py) / 77.6): canister top at its tail y 437 (z 2.19); at px 650 y 392 (x 0.35, z 2.77); at its front end, px 897, y 377 (x 3.54, z 2.96); the nose tip px 1016, y 412 (x 5.07, z 2.51); the cab roof y 440 (z 2.15) from px 940 to the cab front at px 1055 (x 5.57); the near front-pair rear tyre, px 750 to 835, centre px 792, y 565 (x 2.18); a tall lamp post hides px 897 to 940, where the canister meets the cab.

must_show: the canister lying along the whole body between the equipment sides, tail flush with the body's rear at x -5.64, rising 5.5 degrees nose-up toward the cab: its top z 2.19 at the tail, 2.77 at x 0.35
seven dark hoops round the canister, evenly spaced from 0.6 m to 8.6 m along it
the long pale nose cone running out of the canister's front end at the cab's back wall (x 3.30) and standing over the cab roof to its tip at x 5.0, z 2.4

a forward-control cab, x 3.30 to 5.64, roof z 2.12, with the raked windscreen, two side windows, door, mirrors on arms, the steps below the door hung on two straps, lamp clusters and a grille, the bumper with two tow hooks
five axles: three at the rear (x -4.67, -3.00, -1.19) under the body, two forward (x 2.16, 3.96) under the cab, the big lugged single tyres 1.22 m across
the body's flat sides, x -5.64 to 3.25, foot z 1.03 to top z 1.93, carrying equipment lockers with doors and louvres, a ladder near the front (x 2.70), grab rails along the top
the dark wheel-arch cut-outs over the three rear axles (x -4.67, -3.00, -1.19) in the body sides, the red tail lamps on the rear face at x -5.64

landmarks.name: near front-pair rear axle centre
landmarks.note: [DF1] the tyre px 750 to 835, centre px 792 -> x 2.18; the height is not checked (the tyre reads 85 px = 1.10 m against the model's 1.22: the shadow eats its rim)

landmarks.name: canister top at mid-length
landmarks.note: [DF1] y 392 at px 650 (x 0.35); a hoop (2 cm proud) may lie under the station

landmarks.name: nose tip
landmarks.note: [DF1] px 1016 (x 5.07). Its height reads z 2.51 on the photograph, the model has 2.37: not checked - see not_confirmed

landmarks.name: cab roof top
landmarks.note: [DF1] y 440 between px 940 and 1055; the selection is the painted surfaces ahead of the canister (x 3.6 to 5.7): the nose cone over the roof is another material

not_confirmed: the canister's pitch: [DF1] reads 4.9 degrees (tail to its front end), 5.5 (tail to mid-length) or 6.3 (tail to the nose tip) because the cab is nearer the camera than the tail; 5.5 is drawn, so the nose tip sits 0.14 m under the photograph's reading and the canister's front top 0.1 m over it
where the canister ends: [DF1]'s lamp post hides px 897 to 940; it is drawn ending at the cab's back wall (x 3.30) where the photograph's pale cone first shows at px 940 (x 4.09)
the cab's length and its back wall (hidden by the same post); the cab's far side, the erector rams, the jacks (no photograph)
the tyre size (1.22 m from the first builder's reading; this re-reading gives 1.10 m off a tyre in shadow)
the round's tail end inside the canister and the hinge at the rear of the frame (render3d's podelev pose; not photographed raised)
